name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair Campbell's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his family's farm in rural New Zealand. This hands-on experience fueled a passion that led him to pursue engineering. After graduating, he quickly climbed the ranks, first as a performance engineer before transitioning to management roles within smaller racing outfits. His sharp strategic mind and knack for identifying talent caught the eye of Team Gtechniq, who headhunted him to lead their team.

Alistair believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. He is known for his meticulous planning and data-driven decision-making, but also trusts his gut when it comes to race strategy. He is a strong believer in continuous improvement and constantly seeks innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge. 

What sets Alistair apart is his uncanny ability to remain calm under pressure. He has a unique way of inspiring confidence in his team, even when the odds are stacked against them. Alistair's leadership style is a unique blend of technical expertise, strategic vision, and unwavering belief in his team's potential.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Alistair is a man of average height with a strong build, reflecting a life spent both in the office and in the garage.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on personally reviewing the telemetry data from every practice session, no matter how late it gets.
